title: Unified intervention layer with click-to-inspect detail panel
description: Merge the published Martin-tile 'Interventions' layer and the client-side draft/proposed 'My & Proposed Interventions' overlay into one layer toggle, styled by status; add click interactivity on any intervention feature (point or polygon, any status) opening a detail panel that shows the full drawn geometry plus every field; add net-new commenting and liking to that panel, with an explicit design question about /feed parity.

dependencies.note: Landed the draft/proposed client GeoJSON overlay (intervention-drafts-source), its status-based orange-for-pending-review styling, and the drawing tool that produces the full polygon/point geometry this track's detail panel must display.

Just shipped the AiInterventionWorkspace shell (switchable AI-analysis / intervention-proposal panes, right-edge, keep-alive state). This track's detail panel is a candidate third mode or a separate popup; the spec makes an explicit recommendation rather than silently colliding with that shell's OQ-2 'new dedicated surface, nothing else joins it uninvited' precedent.

castModerationVote/transitionLifecycleState is dead/misleading; contributions.publishContribution/rejectContribution (expertProcedure) is the only real publish/reject path. This track's detail panel reads status and reviewNote; it must not add a second moderation surface or re-solve that landmine.

owns: New detail-panel component(s), location TBD in planning (candidate: src/components/panels/InterventionDetailPanel.tsx or a mode inside AiInterventionWorkspace)
New comment/like tRPC procedures and schema, location TBD (candidate: new interventions.ts procedures + a new schema table)
touches: src/components/map/LayerManager.tsx (click handler wiring for the merged layer)
src/components/map/HoverTooltip.tsx (read-only reference for the existing hover pattern; not expected to change)
src/app/feed/InterventionFeed.tsx (only if OQ resolves toward shared detail-panel component reuse)
